page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 96 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. It does not feature any local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. The lack of hyperthreading ensures that each vCPU maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention at the thread level.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed provide predictable compute performance for demanding workloads without the overhead of shared-thread virtualization. This hardware profile is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, high-throughput web serving, build systems, and database workloads that require consistent CPU performance and a balanced memory-to-core ratio.
